source.text_it: Gli organi della lubrificazione dei motori a scoppio e Diesel hanno lo scopo, tra l’altro, di lubrificare la pompa di alimentazione

records.localized_text: Lubrication components in spark-ignition and diesel engines also lubricate the feed pump.

source.text_it: La pompa ad ingranaggi del sistema di lubrificazione di un motore è azionata da un alberino che prende il movimento dal volano motore

records.localized_text: An engine lubrication gear pump is driven by a shaft receiving motion from the engine flywheel.

source.text_it: E' importante che l’impianto di lubrificazione provveda ad una efficace lubrificazione di tutte le cinghie

records.localized_text: It is important that the lubrication system effectively lubricate all belts.

source.text_it: I filtri dell’olio di un veicolo pesante sono tre: uno a cartuccia, uno a carboni attivi, uno a rete metallica

records.localized_text: A heavy vehicle has three oil filters: cartridge, activated-carbon and wire-mesh.

source.text_it: Il livello dell’olio lubrificante del motore si controlla grazie a un manometro installato sul cruscotto del veicolo

records.localized_text: Engine lubricating oil level is checked using a dashboard pressure gauge.

source.text_it: Una pressione troppo elevata dell'olio di lubrificazione del motore può essere causata dall'usura degli ingranaggi della pompa dell'olio

records.localized_text: Excessive engine lubricating oil pressure may be caused by wear of oil pump gears.

source.text_it: Esistono due tipi di filtro dell’olio: uno per la stagione invernale e uno per quella estiva

records.localized_text: There are two oil filter types, one for winter and one for summer.

source.text_it: L’olio esausto può essere diluito in almeno 25 litri di acqua distillata e poi immesso nel circuito fognario

records.localized_text: Used oil may be diluted in at least 25 litres of distilled water and discharged into the sewer.

source.text_it: In un impianto di raffreddamento a liquido, il liquido si riscalda circolando nelle intercapedini ricavate nel monoblocco e nella testata intorno ai cilindri

records.localized_text: In liquid cooling, coolant warms as it circulates through passages in the block and cylinder head around the cylinders.

source.text_it: In un impianto di raffreddamento a liquido, il liquido cede il calore sottratto al motore all'atmosfera tramite il radiatore

records.localized_text: In liquid cooling, coolant releases heat taken from the engine into the atmosphere through the radiator.

source.text_it: Il radiatore è uno scambiatore di calore liquido-aria

records.localized_text: A radiator is a liquid-to-air heat exchanger.

source.text_it: Il liquido di raffreddamento deve avere una bassa temperatura di congelamento, un'alta temperatura di ebollizione e proprietà anticorrosive

records.localized_text: Coolant must have a low freezing point, high boiling point and anticorrosive properties.

source.text_it: Un eccessivo riscaldamento del liquido di raffreddamento del motore può essere dovuto alla valvola termostatica malfunzionante

records.localized_text: Excessive engine coolant heating may be caused by a malfunctioning thermostat valve.

source.text_it: Il raffreddamento del motore evita che una temperatura eccessivamente elevata danneggi le varie parti del motore

records.localized_text: Engine cooling prevents excessive temperature from damaging engine parts.

source.text_it: Il radiatore è l'elemento che permette che il liquido del circuito di raffreddamento non superi una temperatura dannosa per il motore

records.localized_text: The radiator prevents cooling circuit fluid from exceeding a temperature harmful to the engine.

source.text_it: Il circuito di raffreddamento è costituito in modo tale da portare l'acqua del circuito a una temperatura che può anche essere più alta di 100°C

records.localized_text: The cooling circuit is designed so its water may reach a temperature above 100°C.

source.text_it: Nei climi freddi è indispensabile mettere anticongelante nel circuito di raffreddamento

records.localized_text: In cold climates antifreeze must be added to the cooling circuit.

source.text_it: Normalmente il liquido di raffreddamento del motore è acqua distillata

records.localized_text: Engine coolant is normally distilled water.

source.text_it: In un impianto di raffreddamento a liquido, la testata del motore è dotata di alette per aumentarne la superficie e favorire lo scambio termico con il liquido

records.localized_text: In liquid cooling, the cylinder head has fins to increase its surface area and heat exchange with the liquid.

source.text_it: Il liquido di raffreddamento deve avere una bassa temperatura di congelamento e una bassa temperatura di ebollizione

records.localized_text: Coolant must have a low freezing point and a low boiling point.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di raffreddamento dei veicoli moderni non è mai necessario verificare il livello del liquido in quanto l'impianto stesso è sigillato

records.localized_text: Modern vehicle cooling systems never require a coolant level check because they are sealed.

source.text_it: Negli impianti di raffreddamento dei veicoli moderni non è consentito utilizzare l'acqua in sostituzione del liquido refrigerante

records.localized_text: Modern vehicle cooling systems do not permit water to replace coolant.

source.text_it: In caso di elevata temperatura del circuito, è buona norma aprire immediatamente il tappo del radiatore

records.localized_text: If cooling circuit temperature is high, immediately open the radiator cap.

source.text_it: La ventola del radiatore entra in funzione per evitare il congelamento dell'acqua

records.localized_text: The radiator fan starts to prevent water from freezing.

source.text_it: In caso di elevata temperatura del circuito di raffreddamento, è buona norma buttare un secchio di acqua molto fredda sul motore

records.localized_text: If cooling circuit temperature is high, pour a bucket of very cold water on the engine.

rows.text: The quiz marks this FALSO: the engine-oil circuit mainly lubricates engine parts, while the fuel circuit supplies the pump. Design matters, however: some injection pumps use engine oil, while others are lubricated by fuel.
evidence: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/sg/services_and_support_6/downloads_18/diesel_system_components.pdf — Bosch pp.9–10 PDF locale visualizzato: pompe d’iniezione in linea lubrificate da circuito olio; VE/VP da carburante. Non prova esclusione universale della pompa di alimentazione.

rows.text: The pump is driven mechanically by the engine, for example through gears connected to the crankshaft; it is not necessarily driven by the flywheel.
evidence: Caterpillar, pompa olio 231-5127, https://parts.cat.com/en/catcorp/product/231-5127: comando dal motore e circolazione dell’olio.

rows.text: Not all belts are lubricated: oil contamination can damage belts designed to run dry. Special belts designed to run in oil also exist.
evidence: Continental Power Transmission Group, Workbook, printed pp. 9–11 (PDF pp. 5–6), https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/770c5612-19ba-499a-ab6c-5146cbd70b47/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf — protect timing belts from oil, and replace if oil or other fluid contamination is found.
Gates Belt-in-Oil, https://www.gates.com/gb/en/innovations-and-solutions/innovations/belt-in-oil.html — belts designed specifically for operation in oil.

rows.text: There is no required set of three filters of these types. The oil filter traps impurities and its arrangement depends on the engine; activated carbon is used, for example, in cabin air filters.
evidence: MAHLE, Filter Types, p. 5, https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/media/local-media-north-america/pdfs-%26-thumbnails/catalogs-and-literature/filters/fi-70-15_powersports_filter_catalog.pdf: filtrazione e tipi a cartuccia e avvitabili; MANN-FILTER CUK 3554, https://www.mann-filter.com/us-en/catalog/search-results/product.html/cuk3554_mann-filter.html: carbone attivo nel filtro aria abitacolo.

rows.text: The gauge indicates pressure, not level. Check the level with the dipstick or, where fitted, the vehicle’s electronic indicator.
evidence: Ford, Owner Guide p. 28, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/catalog/owner_guides/96motog1e.pdf: manometro misura pressione; Ford, manuale p. 350, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/Catalog/owner_information/2KF012720AG-202507-en_GBR.pdf: verifica con astina o indicatore elettronico.

rows.text: Wear of the gears increases internal leakage in the pump and tends to lower oil pressure, not raise it.
evidence: Perkins, Lubrication System, https://s7d2.scene7.com/is/content/Caterpillar/C10852360: ingranaggi della pompa usurati riducono la pressione.

rows.text: The filter traps impurities in the oil and is selected to meet the engine specifications. There is no winter versus summer filter distinction.
evidence: MAHLE, Filter Types, p. 5, https://www.mahle-aftermarket.com/media/local-media-north-america/pdfs-%26-thumbnails/catalogs-and-literature/filters/fi-70-15_powersports_filter_catalog.pdf: filtrazione e tipi a cartuccia e avvitabili; MANN-FILTER CUK 3554, https://www.mann-filter.com/us-en/catalog/search-results/product.html/cuk3554_mann-filter.html: carbone attivo nel filtro aria abitacolo.

rows.text: Used oil is waste that must be collected and disposed of properly: diluting it does not permit discharge into the sewer.
evidence: D.lgs. 152/2006, art. 107 comma 3, https://prefettura.interno.gov.it/sites/default/files/3/2024-08/decreto_legislativo_3_aprile_2006-n_152.pdf: divieto di smaltire rifiuti in fognatura; art. 216-bis: raccolta e gestione degli oli usati.

rows.text: Coolant passes through the block jackets and cylinder head, absorbing heat from the hot engine parts.
evidence: Caterpillar, 3600 Basics, Jacket Water Cooling System, https://emc.cat.com/n/api/pubdirect?media_string_id=LEKQ9085: liquido attraverso camicie cilindri e testata; HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: Hot coolant passes through the radiator, where it gives heat to the outside air, and then circulates back through the engine.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: In the radiator, heat passes from the coolant to the air flowing across its surfaces, making it a liquid-to-air heat exchanger.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: Suitable coolant must resist freezing and boiling during use and protect the system components from corrosion.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: If the thermostat does not open properly, coolant flow to the radiator can be restricted and the engine can overheat.
evidence: HELLA, Cooling system check, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/cooling-system-check/: controllare livello e apertura termostato in caso di surriscaldamento; HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: The system removes heat produced by the engine and helps maintain an operating temperature that protects components from overheating damage.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: The radiator transfers heat from the coolant to the air, helping keep engine temperature suitable for operation.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: In a closed, pressurized system water can exceed 100°C without boiling: pressure raises its boiling point.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: In cold climates coolant with adequate antifreeze protection is needed: water alone can freeze and damage the system.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: Normally an appropriate mixture of water and coolant additive is used, not distilled water alone: the additive also protects against freezing and corrosion.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: In liquid cooling, heat passes to coolant circulating through passages; fins on the cylinder head are typical of air cooling.
evidence: Caterpillar, 3600 Basics, Jacket Water Cooling System, https://emc.cat.com/n/api/pubdirect?media_string_id=LEKQ9085: liquido nelle camicie e testata; Briggs & Stratton, Model N manual p. 2, https://www.briggsandstratton.com/hubfs/briggsandstratton/FAQs/pdfs/Model%20N-domestic.pdf: alette di testata raffreddate ad aria.

rows.text: Coolant needs a low freezing point and a high boiling point to remain liquid over its operating range.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: Even in a closed system, the level must be checked according to the manufacturer’s instructions: leaks or other problems can lower it.
evidence: HELLA, Cooling system check, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/cooling-system-check/: controllare livello e apertura termostato in caso di surriscaldamento; HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: The absolute prohibition is wrong: some manufacturers allow water alone in an emergency to reach a service center. The specified coolant must then be restored; water alone does not provide the same protection.
evidence: Ford, Engine Coolant Check, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1603063&Uid=G1592514&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=3592: acqua ammessa in emergenza, poi ripristino refrigerante; non aprire a caldo.

rows.text: Do not open the cap immediately: the hot system is pressurized and steam and scalding liquid can escape. Wait for the engine to cool.
evidence: Ford, Engine Coolant Check, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1603063&Uid=G1592514&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=3592: acqua ammessa in emergenza, poi ripristino refrigerante; non aprire a caldo.

rows.text: The fan increases airflow through the radiator to remove heat, especially at low speed or when stationary; it does not prevent freezing.
evidence: HELLA, Engine cooling, sezioni Operating principle e closed cooling system, https://www.hella.com/techworld/en/technical/car-cooling-system/engine-cooling/: scambio di calore, radiatore, ventola, termostato, miscela e pressione.

rows.text: Pouring very cold water over a hot engine can cause thermal shock damage. Let it cool without opening the pressurized system while hot.
evidence: Ford, Cleaning the Engine, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1569203&Uid=G1569202&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=gbr&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=8204: acqua fredda su motore caldo può causare shock termico; Ford, Engine Coolant Check, https://www.fordservicecontent.com/Ford_Content/vdirsnet/OwnerManual/Home/Content?ProcUid=G1603063&Uid=G1592514&buildtype=web&countryCode=USA&div=f&languageCode=en&userMarket=USA&vFilteringEnabled=False&variantid=3592: acqua ammessa in emergenza, poi ripristino refrigerante; non aprire a caldo.

issues.reason: Il quesito non specifica il tipo di pompa di alimentazione né distingue pompa di trasferimento e pompa di iniezione. Il verdetto FALSO generale non chiarisce se escluda anche pompe del sistema di alimentazione lubrificate dal circuito motore; non è verificata l’interpretazione tecnica prevista.
checked_sources: John Deere, Mechanical Fuel Systems Operation, Denso and Motorpal In-Line Fuel Injection Pump Operation, p. 03-130-16, https://dealers.doosanportablepower.com/emea/documents/Service/01_Portable%20Compressors/Engine%20Manuals/07_7-71%2C12-56_4IRD5N%20JD/CTM207%20JD_4045_6068_Mechanical_Fuel.pdf: olio motore inviato alla pompa di iniezione; distingue la pompa di alimentazione che fornisce carburante.

Bosch, Conventional diesel systems, https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/sg/services_and_support_6/downloads_18/diesel_system_components.pdf: pompa di iniezione in linea lubrificata dal circuito motore; alcune pompe a distributore comprendono pompa di alimentazione e pompa alta pressione.

issues.reason: The cited Gates preventive-maintenance PDF returns 404, leaving the dry-belt oil-contamination claim unverified by the surviving belt-in-oil page. Replace with an accessible source, e.g. Continental workbook pp.10–11 https://www.continental-engineparts.com/eu/getattachment/770c5612-19ba-499a-ab6c-5146cbd70b47/PTG1223-En-Workbook.pdf.
